standard_prerequisites.name: The sufficient condition for a collection of subsets to be a basis
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 616-618)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the unique topology on the quotient set of the equivalence relation.

core_obligations: Define the equivalence relation: two points are equivalent when they lie in exactly the same members of the given collection, and let the target be the set of classes (proof lines 609-612)

Transport the basis condition: the assumptions on the collection mirror the basis criterion for the family of images, so there is a unique topology on the target making those images a basis and the quotient map continuous (proof lines 613-619)
Read off the properties: openness of the images and exactness of their preimages are immediate from the construction, which gives all three assertions (proof lines 620-622)
proof_roadmap: 在 X 上定义等价关系 x ~ y ⟺ 对每个 U ∈ B 有 x ∈ U ⟺ y ∈ U；令 Y 为等价类集合、f 为自然映射 ⇒ (2) 由构造成立。
B 上关于覆盖与交的条件恰与「子集族成为基」的判据一致 ⇒ Y 上存在唯一拓扑使 (3) 成立、f 连续。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a collection of opens covering the space and satisfying the intersection condition induces a continuous map onto a space in which the images of the collection form a basis and are exactly the preimages of their images (author lemma at source lines 593-607, label lemma-create-map-from-subcollection). The proof (source lines 609-623) defines the equivalence relation of having the same members containing a point, observes that the hypotheses mirror the basis criterion for the family of images and reads off the three assertions (proof lines 609-622). The equivalence relation and the transport of the basis criterion are the content. H3.
